scripts.db:restart: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.db:check: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec postgres pg_isready -U helpdesk -d helpdesk_db
scripts.db:shell: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U helpdesk -d helpdesk_db
